# CJ ENM

> > CJ ENM is a leading Korean entertainment and media company creating untold originals across content, music, commerce, and animation through brands like STUDIO DRAGON, KCON, and Studio Bazooka.

CJ ENM is part of the CJ Group conglomerate and operates across multiple entertainment divisions including broadcasting, film, music (K-POP), musical theater (Broadway/West End), and animation. The company focuses on discovering and distributing Korean content globally while maintaining strong compliance and ethical management standards.
